snippet.title: [Black Vultures] Gameplay Trailer #2｜In-Game Trailer｜BLACKVULTURES
snippet.description:
Add it to your Steam wishlist and join us for the playtest coming in July 2025: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/

We're excited to share the second in-game trailer for Black Vultures: Prey of Greed.
Following your feedback on our first reveal, we've focused on improving the game's visual clarity and overall atmosphere. This new footage reflects that progress and it's only the beginning.
Your feedback has been vital. We're committed to evolving Black Vultures, and we appreciate your continued support.

Learn more about the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/
Join our Discord Server: http://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame
Follow us on X: https://x.com/bv_community
